articles.title: What This Extension Does
articles.summary: A sales and CRM productivity toolkit layered directly onto the golfballs.com admin — templates, tasks, proposals, proofs, and campaigns without switching tabs.

beginner.text: The Golfballs.com extension adds a layer of helper tools on top of the CRM pages you already use. Nothing about the CRM itself changes — the extension watches which page you're on and offers the right tools for it.

rows: Smart templates with live variables, thread previews, case categorization, one-click sends
Margin calculator with real costs, charges/refunds, order dates, watch list, fraud-score glow
Instant search (Ctrl+K), quick tasks, call logging, contact creation, phone finder
Full product catalog with logo/text/monogram customization, gift sets, tracked quote emails
Logo extraction, recolor mockups, 3D ball previews, proof submission
Bulk email from any selection, multi-step conditional outreach with pacing and dry-run

beginner.text: Everything is optional. Each feature has a toggle in Settings → Features, so your team can run as lean or as full a setup as it likes.

articles.title: First Launch
articles.summary: Where the extension's UI lives: the toolbar popup, the floating Actions Shelf, buttons injected into CRM pages, and the order-notes toolbar.

beginner.text: After installing, open any golfballs.com CRM page. The extension injects its UI automatically — there is no separate app to open. You'll meet it in four places:

rows: Click the extension icon in Chrome's toolbar
Pick an email template for the current page, see variables resolve live, and reach quick actions
Floating pill, bottom-right of every CRM page (double-tap Shift)
Context-aware launcher: the actions change based on whether you're on an order, contact, or account
Email rows, text rows, and product images on CRM pages
Hover an email row for a thread preview; hover an order image for the Image Viewer
Inside the notes area on order pages
One-click note save and the Order Date Manager calendar

beginner.text: If something listed here isn't visible, its feature toggle may be off — see Settings → Features, or the troubleshooting article "A modal or button isn't appearing".

articles.title: Initial Configuration
articles.summary: The five-minute setup: pick a theme, set your email identity and signature, review feature toggles, and optionally import your team's preset.

beginner.text: Open the Settings page (extension popup → settings gear, or the Settings tab in the Template Editor). Five things are worth doing on day one:

items: Pick a theme — Dark, Slate, Light, or Cream. Changes apply live everywhere.
Set your email account host — the 'Email account host' field under Developer Settings controls the From identity on sends. It ships with a default that is probably not you; change it first.
Write your email signature — Settings → signature editor. It's auto-appended to emails sent through Power Automate.
Review feature toggles — everything except Power Automate is on by default. Turn off what you won't use.
Import a team preset — if a teammate exported a preset JSON, Settings → User Presets → Import gives you their templates and settings in one step.

beginner.title: Check the From identity
beginner.text: Until you change 'Email account host', emails may go out under someone else's identity. This is the single most important first-run setting.
Power Automate is off by default. Without it, Send opens a pre-filled Outlook window instead of sending silently. See "How Email Sending Works" before enabling it.

articles.title: The Actions Shelf
articles.summary: The floating bottom-right launcher on every CRM page. Double-tap Shift to toggle it; its actions adapt to the page you're on.

beginner.text: The Actions Shelf is a small floating pill in the bottom-right corner of every golfballs.com CRM page. Click it — or double-tap Shift — and it expands into a vertical list of quick actions.

The list is context-aware: on an order page you'll see Margin Calc, Submit Proof, and Charge; on a contact page you'll see Log Call, Add Task, and Gift Catalog. General actions like Search CRM are always available.

intermediate.text: Actions are ordered by relevance: modal-contextual first, then page-contextual, then general — destructive actions always sit at the bottom in red.

articles.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
articles.summary: Four global shortcuts (all rebindable) plus the in-modal composer keys: '/', 1–9, arrows, and Enter.

beginner.text: Rebind the four letters under Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts. A shortcut only fires when its feature toggle is on.

intermediate.text: Inside composer modals (Quick Task, Call Log)

rows: Pick the Nth filtered template (also picks category chips in Email Preview)
Select / advance to the next composer field
Enter composer mode to fill fields without touching the mouse

intermediate.text: The '/' composer is the fastest way to log a call: '/' → category → direction → note → Enter, all without leaving the keyboard.
